name: Industrial Park Virtual-Real Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: A virtual-to-real benchmark dataset for evaluating anomaly detection methods in industrial park environments, paired with comparative experiments.
evaluation_method: AUROC (area under ROC), plus precision/recall/F1 for detection and pixel-level IoU for segmentation
reputation: Niche research benchmark focused on virtual-to-real industrial anomaly detection with limited adoption outside specialized research groups.
notes: Virtual-to-real paired dataset with domain gap between synthetic and real; relatively small / specialized dataset; non-LLM benchmark; results depend on choice of pixel- vs. image-level evaluation.
